To control your player use WASD/Arrow Keys!! You can fly with W/up or loaf with space key.
You can also go to locations by traveling to the side of the screen. Some locations require you to click on them.
Make sure to explore it throughly, as there are hidden locations and quests that come with them.
You can interact with other birds or people by clicking on them.
When interacting, it’s not possible to travel anywhere, teleport or interact with a different thing.
There are 5 buttons in the top right. Let’s go from left to right.
The Settings button lets you save game and adjust volume. The game right now isn’t friendly, but
I will do that in the future, along with hotkey customizing!
Next, there’s the Achievments Button which allows you to see achievements you’ve earned.
Achievements is how you earn money which has no real use right now but cosmetics.
Next, is Inventory, which stores things you’ve gathered.
Then there’s the Teleport feature, which is useful for going places, but you can only go where
you’ve already seen. Last, we have the Stats feature which lets you see your time played and more!
